αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’ · also object of τίουσι, neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’the proper deeds’ (αἴσιμα ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
βάλετ: βάλλω — throw; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (βάλετ’ = βάλετο); in tmesis περὶ … βάλετ’ ’threw around (oneself)’
βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ‘good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός) · also fem. acc. sg., direct object: ’shout’ (τεῦχε βοήν ’was raising a shout’)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γήμασθαι: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., of a woman: ’be married, be given in marriage’
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γυναικός: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg.
δασσάμενοι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic δασάμενοι)
δεδμημένον: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., epic δεδμημένος (= Attic δεδαμασμένος), + dat.: ’overcome (by sleep)’
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’)
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
διοτρεφές: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings); adj., masc. voc. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δμῳάων: δμῳή — slave-woman, bondwoman; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling

εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσαφικέσθαι: εἰσαφικνέομαι — come to, arrive at; aor. inf. mid. (also in the sense of a command, ’go to’)
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εὐεργέα: εὐεργής — well-wrought; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
εὐρύχορον: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-places, spacious; adj., fem. acc. sg. (Ἤλιδ’ ἐς εὐρύχορον ’to spacious Elis’)
εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θήῃ: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇ): ’may make (one) so-and-so’
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’)

καθέξει: κατέχω — hold down, cover, hold fast; fut. 3 sg. (καθ- from κατά before the rough breathing of ἕξει)
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun with a comparative, predicate: ’a greater evil’ (μεῖζον … κακόν)
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
κατέδουσιν: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίουσιν)
κατερύκει: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 3 sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’)
κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.

κινήσας: κινέω — move, set in motion, shake; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shaking’
κτήματά: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl.
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κυδαλίμοιο: κυδάλιμος — glorious, famous; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
κυδρὴν: κυδρός — glorious, honoured; fem. acc. sg.
λακεδαίμονα: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the land in which Sparta lies; fem. acc. sg.

μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)

μέμνηται: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of; perf. 3 sg. (pres. force), + gen.: ’remembers’

μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μελεδήματα: μελέδημα — care, anxious thought; neut. acc. pl.
μενέλαε: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta; masc. voc. sg.

μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
μεταλλᾷ: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 3 sg., contracted (Attic μεταλλᾷ)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’)
μύθοις: μῦθος — word, speech, story; masc. dat. pl.: ’with stories’ (μύθοις τέρπεσθε)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νεστορίδη: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic, of Peisistratus); masc. voc. sg.
νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
νόστοιο: νόστος — return home; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by λανθάνω ’forget’ (νόστοιο λάθηται ’should forget his return’) · also gen. governed by χατίζων ’needing, longing for’ (νόστοιο χατίζων ’longing for his return’)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νύκτ: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, elided (νύκτ’ = νύκτα): ’for the night’
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
ξεινοδόκῳ: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests; masc. dat. sg.

οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)

οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.

οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.

παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
παράκοιτιν: παράκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πεισίστρατος: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
πεμπέμεν: πέμπω — send, escort; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πέμπειν)

ποδὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner (διερῷ ποδί ’on a nimble foot’)
πολλὴν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg.

προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρώτην: πρῶτος — first; fem. acc. sg., in ἐς πρώτην ’to the first (person)’ · also fem. acc. sg. agreeing with an understood object ’her’: πρώτην ἱκέτευσας ’you besought her first’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a named object, ’first’ (πρώτην Τυρὼ ἴδον ’I saw Tyro first’)
πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σάμοιό: Σάμος — Same, an island near Ithaca (distinct from Samos in the Aegean); gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl.
σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στιβαροῖς: στιβαρός — stout, strong, sturdy; masc. dat. pl.
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῶς: σῶς — safe, sound; also ’sure, certain’; masc./fem. nom. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλέμαχ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Τηλέμαχ’ = Τηλέμαχε)
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηϋσίην: τηΰσιος — vain, fruitless, to no purpose; fem. acc. sg.; derivation not agreed
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’ · also pass. inf., ’to be carried’ (by the wind): Βορέῃ προβάλεσκε φέρεσθαι ’would toss it to the North Wind to be carried’
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλοιο: φίλος — dear; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
φαίδιμον: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. acc. sg.
φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’
φυλάσσει: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over, keep; pres. 3 sg.
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρυσόθρονος: χρυσόθρονος — golden-throned; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses (an old alternative derives the second element from θρόνα ’embroidered flowers’)
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
ἀέκητι: ἀέκητι — against the will of, in despite of; + gen.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant, bright; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἀγχίμολον: ἀγχίμολος — coming near, close at hand; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’close by, hard upon’
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the fragrant food/substance of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμείνω: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); neut. nom. pl., contracted from ἀμείνονα
ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both ways, on both counts’
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg.: ἀμύμονα Λαοδάμαντα ’blameless Laodamas’
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along; prep. + acc.: ἀν’ ἰθύν ’in a straight line’ · also + acc., ’throughout, up and down’ (ἀν’ Ἑλλάδα ’throughout Hellas’)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
ἀπόπεμπε: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’send (him) away’
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀφίκηαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἀφίκῃ)
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. sg.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive plain; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄστεα: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. pl.
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἅρματ: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. acc. pl. (pl. for a single chariot), elided (ἅρματ’ = ἅρματα)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’willing’ (οὐκ ἐθέλοντα ’not willing, unwillingly’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’ · also, same spelling, fut. inf. (Attic ἐλᾶν): ’to be going to drive’, told apart only by context
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπίουρος: ἐπίουρος — guardian, overseer (ἐπί + οὖρος); masc. nom. sg.
ἐποτρύνει: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. 3 sg.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic εἶ)
ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’of (those) being’ (θεῶν αἰὲν ἐόντων ’of the gods who are forever’)
ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’ (νηῶν ἑκὰς ’far from the ships’)
ἑλλάδα: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, here a district of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔεδνα: ἔεδνα — wedding gifts, bridal gifts (prothetic ἐ-, beside ἕδνα); neut. acc. pl.
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔλθῃς: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 2 sg.
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’) · also with a dat. of the possessor, ’have’ (ἅσσα μοι ἔστιν ’whatever I have’) · also existential, ’there is’ (ἐν … νηὶ … βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ἔστιν ’in the ship there is food and drink’)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’ · also adjectival, with a noun: ’each piece’ (ὅπλα ἕκαστα) · also neut. nom. pl. in apposition: ’each’ (πεντήκοντα δ’ ἕκαστα ’fifty to each’)
ἕν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡδέος: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc./neut. gen. sg.
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; neut. acc. pl., ἤπια εἰδέναι ’be kindly disposed’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — long for, strain toward, be eager; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing’ (οἴκαδε ἱέμενοι ’longing for home’)
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄνειαρ: ὄνειαρ — help, benefit, remedy, boon; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὄρχαμε: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (etymology uncertain); masc. voc. sg.: ’chief’ (ὄρχαμε λαῶν, variant of ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὑπερφιάλους: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant, presumptuous; masc. acc. pl.
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under, beneath; + gen., dat. or acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ ... ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’aroused’)
ὑῶν: ὗς — pig, swine; masc./fem. gen. pl. (Attic ὑῶν)
ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
